Name: Seasonal Outfits for SVE (Vanilla Style)
Author: Poltergeister
Description:
Welcome!

This mod adds seasonal outfits for the characters featured in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url] as showcased in the picture section. It is meant to be used with other mods that change the seasonal outfits of the vanilla characters such as [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2449]Seasonal Villager Outfits.[/url] If you want to try out another look for the SVE characters, consider downloading [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic for SVE.
[/url]Please understand that already existing portraits and sprites won't be changed.

[b]Config[/b]

You can choose to have the default Sophia in the game, or an older looking version by setting "OlderSophia" to "true"

[b]Submit your own designs[/b]

I (Poltergeister) won't be creating more outfits for this mod, except for NPCs added in the future. However, if you feel there should be more and you have a good idea for an outfit, feel free to submit your creation (you will of course be credited). There is an optional file in the mod downloads with portraits of the SVE NPCs without any clothing, so you'll have an easier time drawing on them. You need to submit both the portraits and sprite sheets. Please also be aware that this mod is open source and by agreeing to have your design featured, you are also agreeing to the use of your design and art in other mods (like anime or diversity edits). Thank you!
[b]
Thanks to [url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/index.php?/user/71489923-uhteen21/]Uhteen21[/url] for their Victor Luau and Olivia Egg festival submission!
Thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/48457668]lillifer[/url] for their Sophia Egg Festival, Susan + Sophia Luau and Sophia Moonlight Jelllies submission!

Permission and Credits     [/b]  

Outfits created by Poltergeister and Tanpoponoko. 2.0.0 Code by Agent Lyoko. You can freely edit these sprites and portraits for/include them in your own mod as long as you give credit as outlined in the credits section.

I hope you enjoy this mod!

Downloads.Description: These are portraits for the NPCs in SVE without clothing for easier drawing. Submit your designs if you want to see more clothing variety in SVE.

2.0.0 switches to the new appearance system. characters can now be turned off individually (e.g. Wizard for replacements). Deleting any png files from the mod will now break it.

Huge thanks to Agent Lyoko who rewrote the whole mod!
